job.name: CI Tools Monthly Digest
job.description: Publish an English digest of the previous complete UTC calendar month through a CI Tools merge request.

payload.message: Read skill `ci-tools-digest` and publish the previous complete UTC calendar month's English digest as a merge request in xrow-public/ci-tools at docs/digest/digest-yyyy-mm.md. Reuse that month's existing open digest MR. Never substitute a rolling window or claim an unfinished month is complete.
